summary: Prepare for PMP exam scenarios through project artefacts, earned value practice, and PMI-based study. Explore the five-day course.
lede: PMP exam preparation helps project coordinators, project managers, and delivery leads connect project controls with exam-style decisions. You’ll practise building scope and risk artefacts, analysing schedules and earned value, and selecting responses to team, delivery, and change scenarios. It also covers stakeholder engagement and how proposed changes affect approved baselines.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals preparing for the PMP exam who already encounter project work, delivery decisions, or project controls. It suits early-career project practitioners and professionals moving into project management responsibilities.
modules: PMI Exam Content Outline and Project Context
Work Breakdown Structure and Scope Baseline
Schedule Network and Critical Path Method
Cost Baseline and Earned Value Management
Risk Register and Integrated Change Control
Agile Practice Guide and Exam Readiness
prerequisites: Recommended: basic familiarity with workplace projects and common project documents. No coding is required; basic spreadsheet use will support the earned value exercise.
